title: Selector agreement at zero
statement: Choose two independent uniform bits $U,V$ and two independent uniform signs $X,Y\in\{-1,1\}$. For each sign, select $U$ if it is $1$ and $V$ otherwise. The probability that the selections made using $X$ and $Y$ agree, averaged over all four choices, is $3/4$.
